execution.resource_scope: Docker stats valid for Desktop VM; host /proc-derived harness thread/cgroup metrics excluded from interpretation

original_acceptance.semantics: proof correctness, run completion, signed-run physical quantum, requested/effective generator batching, ingress capacity, chain capacity, validator canonical cleanup, and reproducibility are independent acceptance dimensions

original_load_level_acceptance.semantics: load_validation proves the offered level only; it does not establish chain capacity

measurement_interior_diagnostics.semantics: Observation only. Match timestamps to B measurement; startup/drain may be included. Stage wall times overlap. Maxima are lifetime values. Executor counters are concurrent snapshots. Thread CPU excludes vanished threads; network counters cover the network namespace.

reconciliation.semantics: Reconciliation calls only. Outcomes partition apply_calls; balance changes and effects overlap these outcomes. Unchanged account facts can still require expiry/prefix work. Legacy sources_advanced includes admission progress. Manager waiting is wall time, not CPU time. Missing timings are not zero work.

independent_load_margin.semantics: Report observed throughput separately; an unpaced capacity claim requires at least five percent actual offered overdrive.

dashboard_full_measurement_minutes.semantics: Dashboard corroboration only; complete minute buckets inside measurement; proof-checked generator canonical TPS remains authoritative.

delivery.semantics: Diagnostic collated candidates in generator measurement interval, not independently canonical-filtered; timings overlap. Pending epoch does not prove ready work. Published probe lower bound does prove completed publication before probe.

caveats: These captures bracket client startup through full cleanup, not the 600-second measurement cohort. No TPS or per-second rate is inferred.
Only matching (overlay_id, adnl_id) sections with stable mode/metadata and nondecreasing valid counters contribute net deltas.
New, removed, reset, mode-changed, missing or invalid sections are excluded rather than filled with zero. Their endpoint lifetime counters remain visible for diagnosis.
A session can be created and retired entirely between endpoints; even identical endpoint sets and monotonic counters cannot prove complete coverage or uninterrupted actor identity.
Net increases are observable lower bounds between each section's corresponding observations. Reset-and-regrow within a matched section can conceal additional work.
After-endpoint lifetime counters are not interval deltas and may include work before the run. They are never added to the interval lower bound.
The reuse fraction describes matched net counts only; it is not a lower bound on the global reuse fraction or a CPU saving.
crypto_checks counts entry into the original signature-check path (including certificate/type/factory failures), not exclusively completed Ed25519 operations.
